t: Low odour, flexible acrylic caulk for sealing gaps and cracks in plastered walls, ceilings and wood. Suitable for use around window and door frames, architraves, staircases and coving. Can be used before painting and wallpapering for a professional, smooth finish. Paintable with most water-based and synthetic paints. Technical drying time approximately 48 to 72 hours. Cartridge gun application.
